detail.longDescription:
The ReactOS open-source operating system has seen its NTFS file-system driver
mature to the point that it can be finally used for installing and using ReactOS
with it. NTFS formatting support is also finally now possible with this driver
too. Hitting this major milestone of its NTFS driver maturing to the point of
installing and using the ReactOS operating system itself with it also puts the
project one step closer to its elusive beta release. ReactOS posted to X today
this big goal being realized of the NTFS driver being much more mature for
handling ReactOS installations. It is important to note though that the ReactOS
NTFS driver still lacks caching leading to slower performance than other NTFS
drivers/platforms, journaling, and security support are also not yet
implemented. There is also the possibility of other undiscovered bugs they note.
A nice milestone for ReactOS and the latest in a variety of nice achievements
they have made so far in 2026.
